text_block_list.name: Super Creek
Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*. Why do I have to work as a 
vendor...

text_block_list.name: Same Group Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Come on now. Just think of it as giving 
back to the shopping street that's always 
taking care of us. What was it called, the 
Community Revitalization Project? I don't 
think it's that bad~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Welcome.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! Do you have a recommended 
blend from the staff?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Eh...... No, not particularly.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Customer A
text_block_list.text: Ah, I... I see~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My personal recommendation would be the 
apple, mandarin orange, and banana mix. 
The sweetness blends together wonderfully, 
dear~.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, sounds great! In that case, I'll 
have one of those, please.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your purchase~. Please come 
again soon~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Um... thanks for backing me up, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Next time, ...I'll manage on my own.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I'm sorry, dear. Seeing you try 
your best just made me step in without 
thinking~.

text_block_list.name: Groupmate Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Creek-sa~n, please help us over here~.

text_block_list.name: Groupmate Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no fair~! I want you to teach me the 
secrets to customer service later too~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: All right, all right~♪ I'm on my way~.

text_block_list.name: Groupmate Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Creek-san really is amazing, isn't she~? 
She's kind, attentive, and great at 
customer service on top of that!

text_block_list.name: Groupmate Horse Girl D
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-chan is her roommate, so you get 
pampered all the time, right? I'm so 
jealous~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hah? ...I'm not getting pampered, for your 
information.

text_block_list.name: Groupmate Horse Girl D
text_block_list.text:
No way, she was just helping you out a 
moment ago. That's the kind of thing I'm 
jealous of~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That was..., tch!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I can handle things... totally fine on my 
own...!

While doing the rounds through the 
shopping arcade as an intern chaperone, I 
spotted Narita Taishin trying to draw in 
customers in front of a shop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
W-Welcome...! Hey, you over there... no, I 
mean, dear customer. Would you like some 
carrot juice—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ............They walked away.
choice_data_list:
(She's trying her best, but... it's having 
the opposite effect.)

(She's trying her best, but... it's having 
the opposite effect.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, "cheerfully with a smile" is just 
impossible for me. Isn't there anything in 
here that someone like me can actually do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. ...I can do it myself. ...Why 
don't you go check on another group?

She was acting cold and dismissive, but it 
was clear she was struggling. If I could 
lend a hand without making it look like 
help—
choice_data_list:
Then you shouldn't rely on the manual 
either, right?

In that case, I'll take one carrot juice, 
please!

text_block_list.text:
Rather than staring down at the ground, it 
would definitely be better to look the 
customers in the eye and speak to them in 
her own words.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Humph. I can do this just fine 
without something like this anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—If you're tired, try this. It's 
"Full-of-Energy Carrot Juice".

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I drank some myself, and... it really gave 
me energy.

text_block_list.name: Arcade Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Huh... So it's guaranteed? Well, maybe 
I'll go take a look.

Perhaps because Narita Taishin's hard work 
bore fruit, more and more customers kept 
coming after that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haha. Alright, I actually did it—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you for your purchase. 
Everything that girl said in her pitch is 
true~. She's incapable of telling a lie, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her try so hard just makes you want 
to cheer her on, doesn't it? I understand 
completely~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...What the. So in the end, she was 
covering for me after all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Eh? ...Oh, right. If you're buying, go 
over to the cashier.

I bought some juice and walked back over 
to Narita Taishin. Then, timing it with a 
crowd of pedestrians walking by, I chugged 
it down all at once.
choice_data_list:
Sooo good~! And it seems packed with 
nutrients too!

Sooo good~! And it seems packed with 
nutrients too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...What, are you trying to play shill? 
That's so fake—

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Mommy~, that juice looks delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Arcade Customer C
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really does♪ Excuse me, could we 
get two of whatever that person was 
drinking?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Please place your order at the 
counter over there—

Following the parent and child, more 
customers began trickling in, and the 
juice stand run by Narita Taishin and the 
others was thriving.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The shill thing... was honestly a big 
help, but after that, I'm pretty sure I 
handled drawing people in properly... Even 
on my own, I—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hello~, you can sample some right over 
here~. Please have a sip, if only a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Creek-san, is that—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, watching the two of you interact 
gave me the idea. It's all thanks to both 
of you~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
............So without even realizing it, 
she was helping me out again...
